name: Kawauchi Suzu
source: Suzu is second year student and Akria's younger sister and Akira's classmate. In the school. Suzu is the representative of Suzu's class. Now Suzu and Akira live in the same house without their parents because they live overseas. Suzu does all the housework and rule the Kawauchi household. Suzu doesn't lose her composure anytime and makes a cold judgement. She loves Ice Cream and keeps ice cream in the Kawauchi freezer. To tell the truth, Suzu is mentally wealk and easy to lose sight of herself.
